envelope.description: Forward worker keystore calls to the main thread

body.title: Forward worker keystore calls to the main thread
body.summary: Serve the vault to workers through a hub operation and install the forwarder in worker-entry, preserving the owner's KeystoreInputError and mapping only availability and transport failures to KeystoreUnavailableError.
acceptanceChecks: Workers on two threads share one Keychain read
A worker never calls the backend directly
A closed hub channel does not fall back to the Keychain
A save on one worker is visible on another
A malformed request from a worker reports KeystoreInputError, the same as on the main thread
